name: world-of-vikings
description: Open-source browser RPG and world editor (monorepo root).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n packages,website,game,editor,api,assets -c gray,magenta,cyan,yellow,green,blue "pnpm run dev:packages" "pnpm --filter @wov/website dev" "pnpm --filter @wov/game dev" "pnpm --filter @wov/editor dev" "pnpm --filter @wov/api dev" "pnpm run dev:assets"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter "./apps/*" --filter "./services/*" --parallel typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test && pnpm run validate
